jobPosting.title: 2027 Summer Student Nurse Internship Program - Detroit Lakes
jobPosting.description:
Job Description:

Spend Summer 2027 at Essentia Health – Detroit Lakes as a Student Nurse Intern.As a Student Nurse Intern, you will work under direct supervision, providing essential support in both routine and technical aspects of nursing care for patients of all ages.

Education Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist with patient care activities while adhering to best practices and protocols.
  • Collaborate with nursing staff to ensure compliance with the Joint Commission and other relevant federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Help maintain a safe and healing environment for patients and families.

 

Wage: $22/per Hour

Internship Dates: June 7th-August 13th, 2027

 

Units Available for Student Nurse Interns:

  • ICU
  • BirthCenter
  • Med/Surg
  • Emergency
  • Surgical Services
  • Critical Access Locations
    • Fosston
    • Ada
    • Graceville

*Unit availability may vary.


Apply Online and Please Attach the Following:

  • Resume
  • Cover Letter outlining your top 3 units of choice
  • Unofficial Transcripts

**Application Deadline December 13th, 2026**

 

 

Requirements:


  • Current enrollment in an accredited nursing program (BSN or ADN)
  • Completion of junior year of a Bachelor’s Nursing Program or 2 clinical semesters of an Associates Nursing Program, graduating no later than May 2028 following the internship 
  • Enrollment and active participation in an approved internship co-operative course at an accredited nursing school in the state of employment for the summer semester
  • Must be able to commit to 30-36 hours/week
  • Students with full/part-time summer class loads will have adjusted hour requirements and must be able to commit to 32 hours every two weeks

Licensure/Certification Qualifications:


  • Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) certification within 1 month of hire  
  • BCLS certifications through Red Cross must be renewed through the American Heart Association if continuing as a senior nurse intern  
  • This certification must not expire during the internship. 

*Summer Interns could continue their internship during the school in a PRN capacity as Senior Intern (space may be limited)*


**Please also note, this is a temporary status position and is not eligible for benefits**
